description: UI modernization pass - Batch 1: Pipeline, Follow-ups, and Dashboard pages. Apply the premium design system (rounded-xl cards, hover:shadow-md + hover:scale-[1.01], colorful badges with rounded-full, smooth transitions, generous spacing, focus:ring-2 on inputs, text-[11px] metadata). Only change CSS classes - no logic/structure changes.
steps: In src/routes/_authenticated/pipeline.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On StageColumn wrapper div, ensure 'rounded-xl' stays, add 'shadow-sm' to border bg-card/50. (3) On DraggableLeadCard and StaticLeadCard, change 'rounded-lg' to 'rounded-xl', add 'hover:shadow-md hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (4) On search Input, add 'focus:ring-2 ring-primary/20 transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) Make filter Buttons have 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (6) On interest badges in LeadCardBody, add 'rounded-full'. (7) Make the 'Stop' button and overdue/days-in-stage text use text-[11px]. (8) Add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out' to mobile navigation buttons.

In src/routes/_authenticated/follow-ups.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) On each follow-up item div (p-3 rounded-md border), change to 'p-4 rounded-xl border hover:shadow-md hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (3) On Card wrappers, add 'shadow-sm'. (4) On action buttons (Check, Settings2, XCircle), add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (5) Make timestamps text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70. (6) Add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out' to the 'Clear filter' button.

In src/routes/_authenticated/dashboard.tsx: (1) Change page container from 'p-4 md:p-8' to 'p-5 md:p-10'. (2) Add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out hover:shadow-sm' to all action buttons (Quiet, Edit layout, Reset, New Booking, New Lead). (3) On view switcher buttons, add 'transition-all duration-200 ease-out'. (4) On the placeholder/loading grid items, change 'rounded-xl' to ensure consistency. (5) The footer tip text should be text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70.
acceptance_criteria: Running `bun run build` completes successfully with no TypeScript errors
Pipeline page has rounded-xl card items with hover:shadow-md and scale[1.01] transitions
Follow-ups page items have rounded-xl with hover effects and shadow-sm on cards
Dashboard page has consistent transitions on all interactive elements
